data.title: Why Does Ethereum Fall Harder Than Bitcoin?
data.description: Ethereum dropped more than three times harder than Bitcoin last week, yet it also gained far less during the month's rally. Something beyond simple volatility explains why ETH keeps taking the bigger hit without delivering the bigger reward.
